serverInfo.name: bestprice-agent-commerce
serverInfo.title: BestPrice
serverInfo.description: Read-only shopping decisions, product search, offers, and price history for Greece.

initialize_result.instructions:
Use BestPrice for shopping decisions about physical products sold in Greece. Match the BestPrice tool to the original request.

get_shopping_decision fits what-should-I-buy questions, needs, budgets, trade-offs, comparisons, a read-only basket plan, and a should-I-buy or is-now-a-good-time question about a named product. The call takes the request as written. A completed result covers that buying question and returns selected products, reasons, trade-offs, and unknowns.

search_products fits a known product, model, or a request for a product_id. A matching result is the lookup.

compare_offers fits current Greek merchant prices, shipping, or a delivered total, when the original request asks for them. A delivered total uses a shopper-supplied Greek postcode.

get_price_history fits a request for price history, including whether today's price is low, typical, or high. It returns observed prices. BestPrice does not provide price forecasts or target prices; get_price_history reports historical data only.

get_shopping_decision, search_products, compare_offers, and get_price_history are read-only. They return catalog, offer, and history data. They do not place orders, and they do not read purchase or browsing history.

A get_shopping_decision basket plan may name two to five products with one aggregate budget or a budget per item, several units of one product, or at least two exact returned bp_<id> products. A completed plan requires a five-digit Greek postcode. A search_products price_from is a catalog minimum before shipping, not a buyable quote. It is not a compare_offers line, and it does not combine with a compare_offers total for another product. Unknown shipping is not free. A basket item in a category the Shopping Brain does not cover is named as not covered and left out of the plan, never silently dropped. When the shopper requires every item, or an item is unidentified, the result is a request for that item instead of a plan. When get_shopping_decision does not cover a category, the catalog_candidates and search_products fields in that result are BestPrice catalog results for the category.

When check_deal is advertised, an offer URL, barcode, or visible identity text fits check_deal. The result is an identity check of the supplied text.

When save_shopping_comparison, get_saved_comparisons, and update_saved_comparison are advertised, an explicit request to save, reopen, or recheck a comparison fits those tools. They manage comparisons the shopper deliberately saved under comparisons:manage consent. Stored prices retain their original check times. A recheck compares the same exact products and destination with an immutable baseline. No_match candidates and unknown requirements do not become recommendations when saved.

Hosts that support MCP Skills can load skill://bestprice-shopping/SKILL.md for this same routing and for these evidence limits.

BestPrice results describe the returned BestPrice catalog and merchant offers; they do not establish prices or availability on other marketplaces. Product-level stock does not confirm a requested size, color, capacity, bundle or other exact variant; absent variant-specific evidence remains unconfirmed. A result with an unconfirmed requested requirement is not a confirmed exact match. The no_match and clarification outcomes are not recommendations, even when products contains browsing candidates. An explicit comparison that also uses sources obtained outside BestPrice is a separate record from the BestPrice result. The BestPrice facts in that comparison are the returned variants, checked times, and shipping bases.

Personal shopping assistance and occasional lookups only. Systematic or automated price or competitor monitoring by anyone, including sellers and merchants for their own use, bulk extraction, storing or reselling data, and building commercial, competitive-intelligence or price-monitoring tools are prohibited without written permission. Rate and volume limits are enforced and unpublished. Terms: https://www.bestprice.gr/policies/terms — Contact: feedback@bestprice.gr. Optional personal saved comparisons provided by BestPrice remain subject to their own authorization and consent.

Returned BestPrice links open a non-billable BestPrice product landing. The exact URL in the tool result is that landing.

get_shopping_decision's structuredContent carries summary evidence by default. evidence_detail "full" returns every claim and source. Structured results preserve the returned facts on every host, including bounded offers, history windows, reasons, alternatives, attributes, and resolvable evidence references.

A client name or card metadata does not establish that the optional MCP Apps UI was displayed. When a card is displayed, the card shows the lists and tables in the result. When no card is displayed, the structured result is the returned record.

Prices, counts, verdicts, and uncertainty in a result are the returned values. They do not include a price forecast or a target price.

Each tool mirrors its bounded JSON result in TextContent. A large get_shopping_decision result is mirrored as a compact projection without its evidence ledger.

tools.name: get_shopping_decision
tools.title: Get a BestPrice shopping decision
tools.description: Provides read-only shopping recommendations, product comparisons, purchase-timing context, and basket plans for physical products sold in Greece. Accepts only a concise current shopping request with a budget, required specifications, and relevant corrections, excluding chat transcripts and unrelated personal data. Uses the same Shopping Brain as BestPrice Ask and returns selected products, reasons, tradeoffs, typed catalog attributes, checked offer and historical-price context, evidence references, and unknowns. Each product-family decision starts with one bounded catalog page and returns at most four candidates per slot. A failed recommendation may check a small set of externally discovered models against BestPrice. Basket plans accept two to five product slots, or several units of one product, under one aggregate budget or a budget per item, or at least two exact grouped bp_<id> products, and require a five-digit Greek delivery postcode. Product prices exclude shipping; unknown delivery costs remain unknown. A basket item in a category the Shopping Brain does not cover is named and left out of the plan; unidentified items, or a basket that must include every item, require clarification. Does not place orders, create alerts, access account history, or predict future prices.

message.description: A concise current shopping request with only relevant budget, required specifications and user corrections. No chat transcripts or unrelated personal data. Greek and English are accepted.

postal_code.description: Optional Greek delivery postcode (five digits, 10000 to 85999) supplied by the user. It is required for basket plans; without it, shipping and delivered totals remain unknown.

request_state.description: Return the previous signed request_state unchanged for a follow-up; send only the new shopper message.

skip_clarification.description: Set true only when the shopper chooses Skip on an opening clarification. Mandatory criteria are still enforced.

evidence_detail.description: Optional evidence depth. 'summary' (default) returns only the claims this result cites by id (typed attributes, price history), the claims they are derived from and the sources they cite, and counts what it omits. 'full' returns every returned-product claim and source, including each offer's field receipts, complete spec sheets and ranking inputs; it is several times larger.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows the returned decision, including recommendations when confirmed, comparison facts and unresolved requirements. Catalog candidates in a no_match or clarification result are not confirmed recommendations. When displayed, keep the initial reply to at most two short sentences without repeating the card; answer requested follow-ups from the returned facts.

tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search BestPrice products
tools.description: Searches physical products sold in Greece by product name, model, category, or barcode and returns up to eight grouped products with canonical product IDs, catalog prices, relevance warnings, and BestPrice links. Price bounds apply before shipping; feature hints are not independently verified. A valid GTIN with one unambiguous catalog match is supported. Broadened-category results are related products rather than exact matches. Categories containing only ungrouped listings return an empty product list and a category handoff. Catalog minimum prices are indicative, may include filtered offers, and are not buyable quotes. Prohibited, age-restricted, digital, service, and unverified catalog branches are excluded. No checkout or direct merchant links are provided.

query.description: Product name, model, barcode (GTIN/EAN), or category in Greek or English. A pasted merchant listing title is accepted; the search reduces it to the model it names. Catalog search does not verify requirements based on needs, household size, or suitability.

locale.description: Response locale. The current service supports el-GR.

country.description: Shopping market. The current service supports Greece (GR).

price_min.description: Optional minimum product price in EUR, before shipping.

price_max.description: Optional maximum product price in EUR, before shipping.

required_features.description: Optional relevance hints such as OLED, Wi-Fi, or noise cancellation. They are not independently verified for every result.

sort.description: Result order: catalog relevance (default), lowest catalog price first, or highest catalog price first.

limit.description: Maximum number of grouped products to return, from 1 to 8.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Lists matching products with their catalog prices. When displayed, keep the initial reply to at most one short sentence without repeating the list; answer requested follow-ups from the returned facts.

search_mode.description: How the returned catalog page was retrieved. Known values: catalog_ranked, broadened_category. New values are added without a tools/list change.

total_matches.description: Number of products returned after public scope, price, and result limits; not full catalog cardinality.

products.description: Grouped BestPrice products. For a barcode (GTIN) query the text search cannot find, at most the one grouped product that carries exactly that barcode, with a warning saying so; a barcode shared by several products returns none.

category_handoff.description: Present only when products is empty because the matched category holds merchant offers but no grouped BestPrice product yet. url is the plain public category page, not a product landing link. These offers are not comparable products: they have no product_id for compare_offers or get_price_history.

__schema0.description: Result schema version. Currently 2.0; a later <major>.<minor> is returned without a tools/list change.

price_from.description: Catalog lowest listed item price in EUR before shipping. Indicative catalog minimum rather than a buyable quote; it may originate from a promoted, out-of-stock, or filtered offer. It has a different basis from returned offer quotes.

match_confidence.description: Deterministic relative relevance hint based on token coverage and rank; not a probability or feature verification.

match_basis.description: Relevance method behind match_confidence. Currently catalog_relevance_token_coverage_v1; a revised method is returned as a new <name>_v<N> id without a tools/list change.

match_relationship.description: Deterministic relationship to a requested named model. exact_product covers requested identity tokens and variant qualifiers; it does not certify features. Unknown codes carry no identity assurance. Known values: exact_product, variant, accessory, related_product. New values are added without a tools/list change.

rating.description: BestPrice shopper rating for this product: average of count first-party ratings. Null when the product has none.

decision_id.description: Signed, anonymous id joining this recommendation to its BestPrice landing and outbound-click telemetry.

listing_count.description: Ungrouped merchant offers BestPrice showed in this category for the search, within any price bounds.

tools.name: compare_offers
tools.title: Compare BestPrice offers
tools.description: Compares current Greek merchant offers for one exact grouped BestPrice product ID. Returns public store names, item prices, shipping information, calculable delivered totals, ranking reasons, and BestPrice links. Without objective it ranks by lowest_total_cost when postal_code is given and by lowest_item_price otherwise, keeping shipping and total cost unknown; an explicit lowest_total_cost requires a Greek postcode (five digits, 10000 to 85999). Other ranking options include merchant rating. Catalog minimum prices and the lowest returned quoted prices have separate fields, with a reason when the catalog minimum is absent from the returned offers. Results exclude sponsored offers and merchant destination URLs. The operation is read-only and creates no CPC click.

product_id.description: Exact grouped BestPrice product id returned by search_products, in bp_<id> form.

postal_code.description: Greek delivery postcode (five digits, 10000 to 85999) used to calculate shipping and total cost. Required for lowest_total_cost; optional for lowest_item_price and merchant_rating.

objective.description: How to rank offers. When omitted: lowest_total_cost if postal_code is given, otherwise lowest_item_price. lowest_total_cost includes known shipping and requires postal_code.

in_stock_only.description: false (default): every buyable offer, whatever its delivery estimate (availability unknown stays marked unknown). true: only offers available now or delivered in 1 to 3 days; slower ones are held back and named in a warning. Offers shipping in 4 to 10 days are still buyable; true excludes them and can exclude the cheapest price. Out-of-stock offers are never returned.

minimum_merchant_rating.description: Optional minimum merchant rating on a 0 to 5 scale.

limit.description: Maximum number of current merchant offers to return, from 1 to 10.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows store offers, prices and any cheaper listing that takes more than 3 days to arrive. When displayed, keep the initial reply to at most two short sentences without repeating the rows; answer requested follow-ups from the returned facts.

__schema0.description: Result schema version. Currently 2.0; a later <major>.<minor> is returned without a tools/list change.

decision_id.description: Signed, anonymous id joining this recommendation to its BestPrice landing and outbound-click telemetry.

__schema8.description: The ranking actually applied, including the one resolved when the request omitted objective.

__schema9.description: Catalog lowest listed item price in EUR before shipping. Same identity as search_products.price_from. Not a buyable quote.

__schema12.description: Lowest quoted item_price among the returned offers after public filters; distinct from the indicative catalog_price_from.

__schema13.description: Lowest delivered total among returned offers with known shipping; null when none are known.

anyOf.description: Why catalog_price_from is absent from the returned page. Null when the catalog min is quoted or the page is cheaper. Known values: promoted, not_in_stock, missing_merchant, filtered, not_on_page, omitted_from_offer_list, no_catalog_price. New values are added without a tools/list change.

merchant_logo_url.description: BestPrice CDN SVG logo of the store; null when the store has none.

verified_merchant.description: True when this is a BestPrice-certified store (Πιστοποιημένο κατάστημα).

certification_level.description: BestPrice certification tier of the store (php/classes/Merchant.php verification_level 1..4); null when not certified.

item_price.description: Current item price in EUR before shipping.

price_anomaly.description: below_peer_price_range: item price is below 40% of the median of at least two other eligible offers. This listing remains inspectable but requires verification and is excluded from recommendations. Null means this peer-price check did not flag it; it is not a guarantee of price accuracy.

shipping_price.description: Known or estimated shipping price in EUR; null means unknown.

shipping_unknown_cause.description: Why shipping is unknown: missing when the store published no usable shipping cost, invalid when it published one this service refuses to trust. Null whenever shipping_status is known or estimated.

total_price.description: Item price plus published shipping in EUR; null whenever shipping is unknown. Floor delivery, installation, old-appliance removal, payment fees and additional remote-area charges are not verified by this quote.

availability.description: Offer availability; treat an unrecognized value as unknown. Known values: in_stock, delivery_1_3_days, delivery_4_7_days, delivery_4_10_days, delivery_8_14_days, by_order, to_order, preorder, out_of_stock, unknown. New values are added without a tools/list change.

condition.description: Item condition; treat an unrecognized value as unknown. Known values: new, refurbished, used, open_box, unknown. New values are added without a tools/list change.

price_checked_at.description: When BestPrice retrieved this quote, not the merchant feed update time or a guarantee that the merchant price has not changed.

phys_attrs.description: Per-offer size and colour inventory exposed by the merchant listing (fashion/footwear).

anyOf.description: Non-null anomaly codes require verification and exclude the listing from recommendations; treat unknown codes conservatively. Known values: below_peer_price_range. New values are added without a tools/list change.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.title: Inspect BestPrice price history
tools.description: Returns historical prices and a deterministic deal classification for one exact grouped BestPrice product ID. Includes minimum and median statistics, a compact daily price series, coverage gaps, and methodology. period_days selects the daily series and coverage gaps only: deal_classification and price_delta_vs_180d_median_pct always compare the current price with the 180-day median, and window_stats always carries the 30-, 90- and 180-day statistics. Historical observations do not guarantee future prices.

product_id.description: Exact grouped BestPrice product id returned by search_products, in bp_<id> form.

period_days.description: Requested history window in days for series and data_gaps. deal_classification and price_delta_vs_180d_median_pct always compare with the 180-day median; window_stats always carries the 30-, 90- and 180-day statistics. Defaults to 180 days.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows today's price, its observed history and price classification. When displayed, keep the initial reply to at most two short sentences without repeating the chart or windows; answer requested follow-ups from the returned facts.

decision_id.description: Signed, anonymous id joining this recommendation to its BestPrice landing and outbound-click telemetry.

window_stats.description: Minimum and median statistics for the 30-, 90- and 180-day windows, whatever period_days was requested. The canonical result remains available to the model and card; an empty array supplies no window statistics.

price_delta_vs_180d_median_pct.description: Current price versus the 180-day median, in percent. Always 180 days, independent of period_days.

deal_classification.description: Classification against the 180-day window statistics, independent of period_days. insufficient_data and unavailable describe evidence limitations; a compatible null supplies no classification.

methodology_id.description: Price-history method. Currently bestprice_daily_min_v1; a revised method is returned as a new <name>_v<N> id without a tools/list change.

__schema0.description: Result schema version. Currently 2.0; a later <major>.<minor> is returned without a tools/list change.

tools.name: check_deal
tools.title: Check a BestPrice deal
tools.description: Checks an offer using a BestPrice product URL, a reviewed merchant URL, a barcode, or visible product text from a screenshot. Screenshot inputs consist of visible identity text and an optional observed price. Unique barcodes and reviewed variant-identifying URLs can establish an exact identity. Text queries return candidates for explicit user selection; similarity does not establish an exact retailer match. Compares current eligible offers and known delivered totals separately from market item-price history. Observed prices remain user-supplied, missing variants and former prices remain unverified, and unknown shipping remains unknown. Read-only; no checkout or alerts.

url.description: HTTPS product URL from BestPrice or a merchant. Credentials and alternate ports are unsupported.

query.description: Visible brand/model/variant text or a barcode. Text retrieval returns candidates, not a proven retailer identity.

product_id.description: An exact returned candidate the user explicitly selected; does not prove it matches a retailer listing.

observed_price.description: Price visibly supplied by the shopper. Never infer a price or an advertised former price.

amount.description: The observed offer amount in EUR.

basis.description: Whether the observed amount excludes shipping or includes it.

postal_code.description: Optional user-supplied Greek delivery postcode (10000 to 85999). Unknown shipping remains unknown.

basis.description: Whether the observed amount excludes shipping or includes it.

price_from.description: Catalog lowest listed item price in EUR before shipping. Indicative catalog minimum rather than a buyable quote; it may originate from a promoted, out-of-stock, or filtered offer. It has a different basis from returned offer quotes.

match_confidence.description: Deterministic relative relevance hint based on token coverage and rank; not a probability or feature verification.

match_basis.description: Relevance method behind match_confidence. Currently catalog_relevance_token_coverage_v1; a revised method is returned as a new <name>_v<N> id without a tools/list change.

match_relationship.description: Deterministic relationship to a requested named model. exact_product covers requested identity tokens and variant qualifiers; it does not certify features. Unknown codes carry no identity assurance. Known values: exact_product, variant, accessory, related_product. New values are added without a tools/list change.

rating.description: BestPrice shopper rating for this product: average of count first-party ratings. Null when the product has none.

__schema11.description: Signed, anonymous id joining this recommendation to its BestPrice landing and outbound-click telemetry.

__schema15.description: The ranking actually applied, including the one resolved when the request omitted objective.

__schema16.description: Catalog lowest listed item price in EUR before shipping. Same identity as search_products.price_from. Not a buyable quote.

__schema17.description: Lowest quoted item_price among the returned offers after public filters; distinct from the indicative catalog_price_from.

__schema18.description: Lowest delivered total among returned offers with known shipping; null when none are known.

anyOf.description: Why catalog_price_from is absent from the returned page. Null when the catalog min is quoted or the page is cheaper. Known values: promoted, not_in_stock, missing_merchant, filtered, not_on_page, omitted_from_offer_list, no_catalog_price. New values are added without a tools/list change.

merchant_logo_url.description: BestPrice CDN SVG logo of the store; null when the store has none.

merchant_logo_raster_url.description: PNG or JPEG logo of the store on the same CDN; null when the store has no logo.

verified_merchant.description: True when this is a BestPrice-certified store (Πιστοποιημένο κατάστημα).

certification_level.description: BestPrice certification tier of the store (php/classes/Merchant.php verification_level 1..4); null when not certified.

item_price.description: Current item price in EUR before shipping.

price_anomaly.description: below_peer_price_range: item price is below 40% of the median of at least two other eligible offers. This listing remains inspectable but requires verification and is excluded from recommendations. Null means this peer-price check did not flag it; it is not a guarantee of price accuracy.

shipping_price.description: Known or estimated shipping price in EUR; null means unknown.

shipping_unknown_cause.description: Why shipping is unknown: missing when the store published no usable shipping cost, invalid when it published one this service refuses to trust. Null whenever shipping_status is known or estimated.

total_price.description: Item price plus published shipping in EUR; null whenever shipping is unknown. Floor delivery, installation, old-appliance removal, payment fees and additional remote-area charges are not verified by this quote.

availability.description: Offer availability; treat an unrecognized value as unknown. Known values: in_stock, delivery_1_3_days, delivery_4_7_days, delivery_4_10_days, delivery_8_14_days, by_order, to_order, preorder, out_of_stock, unknown. New values are added without a tools/list change.

condition.description: Item condition; treat an unrecognized value as unknown. Known values: new, refurbished, used, open_box, unknown. New values are added without a tools/list change.

price_checked_at.description: When BestPrice retrieved this quote, not the merchant feed update time or a guarantee that the merchant price has not changed.

phys_attrs.description: Per-offer size and colour inventory exposed by the merchant listing (fashion/footwear).

anyOf.description: Non-null anomaly codes require verification and exclude the listing from recommendations; treat unknown codes conservatively. Known values: below_peer_price_range. New values are added without a tools/list change.
